name: Combination Discipline — Call Upon the Blood

system.description:
Prerequisites: Advanced Animalism, Intermediate Auspex (Telepathy). This Discipline lets the anarch sense the Beast within nearby Kindred, ghouls and certain were-creatures, scouting numbers and rough proximity without pinpointing exact locations. Costs one Blood Trait to activate and requires a Mental Test against a difficulty of six Traits with the Storyteller (retest Survival), yielding an impression of how many Beasts are nearby. Alternately, the user may test against a single individual to force an honest answer to "Are you a vampire or a ghoul?" Targets may make an Awareness Test to sense the probing, though not its source or direction. Usable for up to 10 minutes at a time; using it more often per night than one's Self-Control/Instinct rating (never more than twice that rating) risks a frenzy test.

Costs 9 Experience Traits to learn.
